text: 压迫感消散了，但饥饿仍在。第二天，西尔维娅虚弱得无法继续前进，你只能尽力让她舒服些。她手指微微颤动，示意你靠近，低声说了几句话，让你若能回家就转告她母亲。一小时后，她死了。
你和诺曼别无选择，只能独自继续疲惫的旅程。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 198
text: The oppressive feeling lifts, but your hunger remains. The next day, Sylvia becomes too weak to proceed; you can only try to keep her comfortable. With fluttering fingers, she beckons you close and whispers a few words to be relayed to her mother if you ever make it home. An hour later, she is gone.
You and Norman have no choice but to go on your weary way alone.
